title: SpaceX agrees to testify to NYC Council about AI safety after receiving subpoena
script:
SpaceX just agreed to testify before the New York City Council.
The company received a formal subpoena regarding its AI safety protocols.
Council members want to know how the aerospace giant manages automated systems.
This follows growing local concerns about how corporations use AI in urban spaces.
The agreement comes after a heated push for transparency from local lawmakers.
Should private companies be held accountable by city councils for their AI use?
